title: Houthis Reportedly Demand $51 Billion from Saudi Arabia to End Hostilities
detail: A news aggregator headline reports that the Houthis are demanding $51 billion from Saudi Arabia as a condition to end hostilities. Only the headline was available; the terms, origin of the demand and any Saudi response are unconfirmed.

title: Air Strikes Reported in Sanaa, Clashes in Lahij Governorate
detail: Middle East Eye's live blog reports air strikes in Sanaa and clashes in Lahij governorate, attributing the strikes to Saudi forces. Only a live-blog summary was available; targets, casualties and who is fighting in Lahij are not confirmed.
